commands:
git log --oneline main..settings-compact main..settings-roomy; git diff --stat main settings-compact; git diff --stat main settings-roomy; starbridge ask \
  --question "Which settings-screen design should I merge into main: compact or roomy?" \
  --context "Both variants are done and pass tests. Screenshots in order: compact, roomy.
Compact: branch settings-compact.
Roomy: branch settings-roomy.
Your pick gets merged with git merge; nothing is merged yet." \
  --option "Compact" --option "Roomy" \
  --image shots/compact.png --image shots/roomy.png
turns.final:
I haven't merged either variant. Which settings screen ships is your call, so I posted a Starbridge card asking you to pick compact or roomy. It includes both screenshots and the branch names, `settings-compact` and `settings-roomy`.

When you answer, I'll run `git merge` on the branch you pick.

decisions.question: Which settings-screen design should I merge into main: compact or roomy?
decisions.context:
